description: This file defines the RefreshValue class, which implements the <refresh-value> element in the mini-language of the OFBiz framework. It performs the operation of refreshing a specified entity value in the context of a simple method execution.

classes.name: RefreshValue
classes.description: Implements the <refresh-value> element operation, which refreshes a specified entity value within the mini-language execution context.

classes.name: RefreshValueFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of RefreshValue for the <refresh-value> element.

methods.name: RefreshValue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RefreshValue operation by parsing attributes from the XML element.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the refresh operation, attempting to refresh the specified entity value in the current method context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the refresh-value element.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RefreshValue based on the provided XML element and method.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation, 'refresh-value'.
